Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 102. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

Thanks to extensive practice with Firearms, you gain
the following benefits:
You ignore the loading quality of firearms with which
you are proficient.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn’t
impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
When you use the Attack action and attack with a
one handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to
attack with a pistol you are holding.
